title: Posterior-First Neural PDE Simulation: Inferring What Downstream Tasks Need from a Single Field
abstract: arXiv:2605.03247v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural PDE simulators often receive only a single observed field at deployment. In this setting, a field-to-future predictor can collapse distinct latent problem states into the same deterministic interface, losing the ambiguity needed for reliable rollout and downstream decisions. We propose posterior-first neural PDE simulation, a task-to-target-to-interface paradigm: the declared downstream tasks determine the minimal task-sufficient problem state to infer, and the posterior over that state conditions the rollout and downstream queries. This posterior can be supplied by amortized posterior estimators, including simulation-based inference with learned summaries; our contribution is the target, the interface, and their theory. translated_title: 后验优先的神经PDE模拟：从单个场推断下游任务所需的信息
translated_abstract: 神经偏微分方程（PDE）模拟器在部署时往往只获得单个观测场。在这种设定下，场到未来的预测器会将不同的潜在问题状态坍缩为同一个确定性接口，从而丢失对可靠滚动推演和下游决策而言必要的歧义性信息。我们提出后验优先的神经PDE模拟，这是一种“任务—目标—接口”范式：所声明的下游任务决定需要推断的最小任务充分问题状态，而该状态上的后验分布则对滚动推演和下游查询进行条件化。该后验可由摊销式后验估计器提供，包括采用学习摘要的基于模拟的推断（SBI）；我们的贡献在于目标、接口及其理论。我们证明贝叶斯下游价值可通过该后验进行分解，精化标签上的严格（proper）评分规则将其识别为总体风险最小化器，而确定性坍缩则会招致歧义性代价……
tldr: 该论文提出“后验优先”的神经PDE模拟范式：由下游任务确定需推断的最小任务充分问题状态，用其后验分布（可由基于模拟推断的摊销后验估计器提供）来条件化滚动推演与下游查询，并从理论上证明贝叶斯下游价值经此后验分解、严格评分规则以之为最优，而确定性坍缩会带来歧义性损失。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a posterior-first neural PDE simulation paradigm, in which downstream tasks determine a minimal task-sufficient problem state whose posterior—supplied by amortized simulation-based inference—conditions rollout and downstream queries, with theory showing that Bayes downstream values factor through this posterior and that deterministic collapse incurs an ambiguity loss.
